verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a model lifecycle page stating that each Serverless API model moves through defined stages from release to retirement, and that developers should use these stages to plan migrations before retirement. This is a first-party deprecation framework. The evidence does not show a specific advance-notice period, a notification mechanism, or concrete migration guidance such as recommended replacement models. missing for 10: stated advance-notice timeframe, deprecation notification channel, per-model migration/replacement guidance, independent corroboration that the policy is honored.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired

citations.quote: Each model on the Mistral Serverless API moves through a defined lifecycle, from initial release to retirement. Use these stages to choose the right model for production and plan migrations before a model is retired.
Labs models are experimental releases intended to collect feedback before we commit to a production model.
